title: LedgerEntry
description: One thing a session did, derived deterministically from a tool call (AIS-797). Identifiers and short titles only, never bodies or mail text.

seq.description: Monotonic within the ledger; pass the last one as `after` to read only newer entries.

ts.description: Unix epoch seconds (same clock as message timestamps).

source.description: MCP server or toolset that served the call.

area.description: Most specific service behind the call, e.g. the upstream server a Suite tool proxies.

status.description: Status of the referenced item as seen after the call.

status_from.description: Last status the ledger knew before a write changed it.

status_to.description: Status a write moved the item to.

count.description: Number of records a list or search returned.

detail.description: Short answer of a decision (clarify), clipped.

lineage_root.description: Root session of the compression lineage; the ledger key.

session_id.description: Session segment the call ran in.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call id; matches tool_call_id of the tool message in the transcript.

LedgerVerb.description: What the call did, normalised from the tool-name tokens.

LedgerRef.description: Identifiers of the item an entry is about; at most one item per entry.

key.description: Human key such as a ticket key.

LedgerPage.description: Response of GET /api/sessions/{id}/ledger and payload of the session.ledger gateway event (delta).

session_id.description: Session the request or event named.

total.description: Entries the ledger holds for the lineage.
